name: Koiiro Soramoyou: After Happiness and Extra Hearts
original_name: 恋色空模様 After Happiness and Extra Hearts
source:
This is the fandisk to Studio Ryokucha’s 2010 title Koiiro Sora Moyou, with after stories for each of the 5 heroines, as well as new stories for the 4 subheroines (Yuuki, Aiko, Kiyomi and Machiko). Returning to peaceful (?) days, Seigo helps the new student council out with the culture festival preparations. Of course, there’s also now more time for sweet love.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是Studio綠茶於2010年推出的《戀色空模樣》的Fan Disc，包含五位女主角各自的後日談，以及四位女性配角優喜、愛子、清美和真知子的全新故事。迴歸和平（？）的日子後，誠悟協助新學生會籌備文化祭。當然，如今也有了更多時間享受甜蜜戀情。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
